headline: A flexible process. A clear learning purpose.
introduction: I use ADDIE to guide analysis and alignment, and Agile practices to iterate with stakeholders and incorporate feedback. The right process depends on the organization, timeline, and learner needs.

phases.title: Discover
phases.description: Explore the performance challenge, audience, context, constraints, and measures of success.

phases.title: Design
phases.description: Map objectives to practice, feedback, assessment, and the learner journey.

phases.title: Develop & Collaborate
phases.description: Build prototypes and drafts; coordinate reviews and document decisions.

phases.title: Deliver & Improve
phases.description: Launch, gather feedback, and iterate based on observable results.

tools_body: Example tools to highlight: Articulate Rise 360, Storyline, Camtasia, Synthesia, iorad, Microsoft Planner, Jira requests, and Confluence.
